content: Azure Firewall for Containers extends Azure Firewall protection to containerized workloads, providing a centralized approach to securing network traffic for container environments. Customers can use Azure Firewall capabilities as part of their container networking architecture while maintaining consistent network security and control. With this preview, organizations can strengthen protection for container workloads while using Azure Firewall as part of their broader Azure network security strategy. Learn more.
